name: 代码简化
description: Improve code readability and maintainability while preserving behavior and following the target project's conventions.

display_description.en: Simplify recently modified code while preserving functionality, following project conventions, and reporting relevant verification.
display_description.zh: 在保持功能和行为不变的前提下，遵循当前项目规范，简化近期修改的代码，提升可读性与可维护性。

default_init_input.en: Use Code Simplifier to simplify the code changed in this session, preserving behavior and following this project's instructions.
default_init_input.zh: 使用代码简化技能优化本次会话修改的代码，保持行为不变并遵循当前项目的规范。

quick_inputs.en: Use Code Simplifier to simplify the code changed in this session, preserving behavior and following this project's instructions.
quick_inputs.zh: 使用代码简化技能优化本次会话修改的代码，保持行为不变并遵循当前项目的规范。

quick_inputs.en: Simplify the changed functions by reducing unnecessary nesting and duplication without changing their behavior.
quick_inputs.zh: 减少已修改函数中不必要的嵌套与重复，保持原有行为不变。

quick_inputs.en: Refine the recently changed code for clarity, run the project's permitted focused checks, and summarize the changes and verification limits.
quick_inputs.zh: 提升近期修改代码的清晰度，运行项目允许的针对性检查，并总结变更与验证限制。
